The desktop app could turn scientific memory on, but there was nothing to do with it: a final report's `[evidence1]` and `[artifact1]` references rendered as literal brackets, and the graph had no surface a reader could reach from the report they were reading. This change makes those references citations the reader can follow, and keeps the one remaining memory surface — the switch — where the reader can act on it. ## A report's citations become chips The alias → node map is persisted on the report version (`references`), and the Markdown reader turns a token only when that map answers for it. `[note]`, an unknown alias, and every report written before the back-fill render as the plain text they are. The transform runs on the mdast tree rather than on rendered text: a chip is a link node carrying `graph://`, so it survives emphasis and line breaks inside a sentence, and the `a` renderer turns it into a button. `urlTransform` lets `graph://` through and still applies the default safety transform to every other URL. Chips travel with the run stream too. The server back-fills `references` onto the persisted message right before `run.completed`, so a live answer and its replay show the same chips instead of the replay falling back to text. ## An artifact citation opens the document, not a record about it An artifact chip opens `ArtifactDialog` over the report: the version the citation pins (not the newest one), with its own picker, and a 溯源 tab. An evidence chip opens the node's own fields — type, locator, confidence, source, recorded time — plus a 溯源 tab with the linear walk the graph recorded: the evidence, the paper or record it came from, the skill that read it, the session that ran it. Neither dialog is a library: closing it leaves the reader in the sentence they were reading. An 上游文件 link inside provenance opens the dependency in the panel beside the dialog instead of replacing the document under the cursor, and the dialog steps aside while the panel is showing it. Pointing the panel anywhere else ends that gesture, so the dialog never keeps an offset for a surface that no longer shows the dependency. ## Settings carries the switch and its state The header capsule polled `/api/health` on a timer whether or not memory was on. It is gone. Whether the service answers is now a line beside 启用科学记忆, read once when the switch turns on, and again only when the reader presses 重新检查. Where the graph is stored stays the memory service's own configuration — the page asks for nothing it does not show. 科学记忆 moves to 智能, after 专家. The line has two readings: 运行正常, or 连接失败. A store that has not been given its credential (a Neo4j deployment's own configuration) used to read 需要密码 here; that named a step no control in this window could take, so it now reads as any other service that is not working, and the state, label and style rule are gone. ## Reading a document twice is a render, not a second read Version bytes are cached module-side per version id, keyed by the client and session, with in-flight reads deduplicated and an LRU cap (24 MB total, 4 MB per entry) so a run of large documents cannot grow without bound. Reopening the artifact dialog, or opening a citation whose dependency is already on screen, issues no second request. The JSON and CSV previews parse once per content instead of once per paint, and `AssistantTurns` is memoised so opening a dialog does not re-parse every answer in the session. ## The memory sidecar can no longer take the stack down `scripts/start-stack.mjs` pins the sidecar's store under the app data directory (an explicit `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_DATA_DIR` still wins), derives its URL from the port this stack binds instead of inheriting a stale one, and degrades to `memoryGraph="degraded"` when the sidecar does not become healthy rather than aborting the whole start. The two behaviours that differ from `start-stack.sh`, and the way back to an existing store, are under Compatibility and migration below. ## Validation **Rebase.** While this pull request was open, `main` advanced 132 commits from `e4c206d1` to `6292b9b2` — 18 of them since the previous rebase point `947d93d0`, touching 58 files (research package, evolve, run-failure cards, MCP and workspace work). The branch was rebased twice; every commit id below is the id from the current rebase. Seven files are touched by both sides — `apps/desktop/src/App.tsx`, `app/use-workspace.ts`, `text/en.ts`, `text/zh.ts`, `views/AssistantTurn.tsx`, `views/ConfirmDialog.tsx` and `tests/assistant-turn.test.tsx` — and one of them conflicted: both sides reworked the Escape handling in `ConfirmDialog`, where `main` still runs its hand-rolled `claimsEscape` keydown effect and this branch's `85285d1f` replaces the same effect with `useTopmostEscape(onDismiss)`. The resolution keeps this branch's hook, which is the commit that builds the escape stack, and `main`'s `useState` for the replacement model. Each paragraph's measurement was made on the tree that commit names before the rebase and describes the same content. On the rebased head `772769a6`: `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` passes, `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` passes, the desktop unit suite passes 959/959 (`# pass 959`, `# fail 0`, `# skipped 0`), and `pnpm ci:l1` passes 4/4. `git range-diff` maps all 14 commits; only `85285d1f` differs, and that difference is the resolution above. Run locally on `06f8c1cc` (Linux x64), when the branch had six commits on top of `upstream/main` at `e4c206d1`, every failure attributed: | Layer | Planned | Executed | Passed | Failed | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | UT | 6541 | 6541 | 6528 | 13 | | ST | 51 | 51 | 50 | 1 | | E2E | 133 | 133 | 127 | 6 | The UT plan grew from 6536 to 6541 with the five tests this branch adds (three for the dialog stack, two for the version in a chip's URL). The 13 UT failures are the same set this branch showed before, all host or upstream, none in this diff: - **10 — `services/launcher/src/serve.test.ts` and `source-evolve.test.ts`.** They write a CommonJS fixture under `os.tmpdir()`; this host carries an unrelated `/tmp/package.json` with `"type": "module"`, so Node parses that fixture as ESM and the child exits 1. Re-running the same tests with `TMPDIR=/var/tmp/...` passes. - **1 — `scripts/start-stack-lock.test.mjs`, "the same harness FAILS on the pre-fix body that restored only on the happy path".** Reproduced identically on a pristine `upstream/main` worktree. - **1 — `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-agent.test.ts`, the trajectory assertion.** The same failure is present on earlier branches of this work on this host. - **1 — `services/runner/src/sandbox-network.test.ts`.** The host's `bwrap` has no `--disable-userns`. The single ST failure, `test/api/evolve-distribution.test.ts`, downloads the pinned CPython runtime from `github.com`, which this host cannot reach; `curl` to that release URL fails from outside the suite as well. The repository E2E layer ran in full at `06f8c1cc`: 133 planned / 133 executed / 127 passed / 6 failed / 0 skipped. Five are the same failures the layer showed at `8ca815e6`; the sixth is this worktree's own immutability guard, not a product assertion — see the table under E2E user journeys. At `06f8c1cc` the diff touched only `apps/desktop/**` and `scripts/start-stack.mjs` — no file under `apps/web`, and not `scripts/start-stack.sh`, the entry point that layer uses to bring its stacks up. Later heads add `docs/**` and one change inside that layer: the reload target of `test/journey-conversation-column.spec.ts` (see `86c957a5` below). Desktop package on `06f8c1cc`: `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` passes, its unit suite passes 867/867 (`# pass 867`, `# fail 0`, `# skipped 0`), and its browser suite (`apps/desktop/e2e`, 123 journeys against a mocked control plane) passes 123/123 — including the journey this branch adds, `Escape closes the card opened over a report's dialog, not the dialog under it`, and the citation and settings journeys the earlier commits added. `81715f2c` (the follow-up that drops the credential state) changed only `apps/desktop/**`. Re-run on it: `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` passes, the desktop unit suite passes 867/867, and the desktop browser suite passes 123/123 — the memory journey now also asserts that a `needs-password` reading renders as `连接失败`, with no 需要密码 label anywhere in the settings page. The four repository slices (L1/UT/ST/E2E) were **not** re-run on this commit: it touches no file under `apps/web` or the launcher, and the numbers above stay attributed to `06f8c1cc`. `130c28a4` and `73a1be77` (the paper abstract, read out of its markup) changed only `apps/desktop/**`. Re-run on `73a1be77`: `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` passes, the desktop unit suite passes 878/878 (`# pass 878`, `# fail 0`, `# skipped 0` — 11 of them the new `paper-abstract.test.ts`), and the desktop browser suite passes 123/123. The evidence journey's fixture now carries a real `

`-sectioned abstract plus the record's `link`; it asserts the abstract renders as its prose paragraphs, that neither a `

`/`

` tag nor a section label (`Background/purpose`, `Methods`, `Results`) reaches the page, and that the link is drawn. The four repository slices were **not** re-run on these commits either, for the same reason. `d04af32e` (a paper's title read as text, not as escaped markup) also changed only `apps/desktop/**` — found by opening the card against the live graph, whose titles carry `<i>BRCA1</i>`. On it: `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` passes, the desktop unit suite passes 881/881 (`# pass 881`, `# fail 0`, `# skipped 0`, 14 of them in `paper-abstract.test.ts`), and the full desktop browser suite passes 122/123 — the one failure, `evolve.spec.ts:218` (a typed design command's confirmation detour), passes 11/11 when its spec is re-run alone, so it is timing under the full suite's parallel load; no file this commit touches is in that journey. `d21cc960` (the provenance's section reads `上游文件` / `upstream file` instead of `派生自` / `derived from`) also changed only `apps/desktop/**`. On it: typecheck passes, the desktop unit suite passes 881/881, and `scientific-memory.spec.ts` passes 9/9. The screenshots of that tab were retaken on this commit. `371e9ae3` is documentation only (`docs/en|zh/advanced-setup/science-memory-setup.md` and `docs/en|zh/reference/configuration.md`): the local store's default is now stated per entry point — `/memory-graph` under `scripts/start-stack.mjs` and the single-file launcher, `~/.science-agent/memory-graph` under `scripts/start-stack.sh` or a directly launched service — with the note that an existing store is not moved automatically. No code or test file changes, so the suites above still describe the same code. `86c957a5` changes one repository journey, `test/journey-conversation-column.spec.ts` (+7/−1): its skeleton step reloaded `/` and expected the app to reopen the Session it was reading, but a bare `/` names no Session, so the app fell back to the first Session of the default Project. The route gate then held `/api/sessions/`, a request the page never made, and the ungated transcript replaced the skeleton before `boundingBox()` could measure it — the failure that made `L2 E2E (mocked, standard-journeys)` red in two consecutive runs (`#151` reading `width` of `null`, earlier `#112` reading `height`). The step now reloads `/projects//sessions/`, the app's normal restore path, where a Session named by the URL wins over the "first item" default. Assertions are unchanged. This commit is a pure rebase of the one that run measured (`git range-diff` reports no patch change), and [run 42373541505](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42373541505) on it is green in full — merge-gate, L1, UT, ST, Coverage, CodeCheck, Freeze mocked E2E, and all five L2 shards including `standard-journeys` — which is the journey's result. `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json` and `pnpm ci:l1` (4/4) also pass locally; the shard itself could not be run on this host, where the isolated E2E stack is terminated before it listens. `772769a6` is documentation only (`docs/en|zh/advanced-setup/science-memory-setup.md`): `` is now named `SCIENCE_DISCOVERY_DATA_DIR`, the variable `scripts/start-stack.mjs` and the single-file launcher actually read, with `SCIENCE_AGENT_DATA_DIR` described as the logged compatibility fallback — matching the configuration reference in this same pull request. `pnpm docs:lint` passes (167 files, 0 issues). ## E2E user journeys The desktop front end has its own browser suite (`apps/desktop/e2e`, every `/api/**` answered by a stateful mock, `tier:l2`). It passes 123/123 journeys on `06f8c1cc`. The rows below describe the final head `772769a6`: three of them exercise commits that landed after `06f8c1cc` — the structured abstract (`130c28a4`, `73a1be77`), the `上游文件` reading (`d21cc960`) and the `needs-password` rendering (`81715f2c`) — and each of those commits' own runs re-ran this suite, as recorded under Validation. | Journey (`scientific-memory.spec.ts`) | Expected | Actual | | --- | --- | --- | | Escape closes the card opened over a report's dialog, not the dialog under it | the card closes and the dialog stays; a second Escape closes the dialog | PASS | | a report's evidence chip opens its details and provenance | the cited node's fields and its provenance walk open over the report; a structured abstract reads as plain paragraphs with no tag or section label on screen, and the record's link is drawn | PASS | | a report's artifact chip opens the artifact itself, in a dialog over the report | the pinned version, with its own picker and 溯源 tab, opens in a dialog | PASS | | a chip press draws the dialog's frame before the version's bytes land | the frame lands first; bytes fill it when they arrive | PASS | | a provenance tab opens at its first line, not where the preview was left | the walk starts at its top | PASS | | an 上游文件 link opens the dependency beside the dialog, not in place of it | the panel shows the dependency; the dialog steps aside | PASS | | a disabled memory graph says so in the card instead of an empty story | the card names the state instead of drawing an empty walk | PASS | | a provenance hop that cannot reach the graph is an error, not an empty story | an error is reported | PASS | | the memory state reads beside the switch, and only while the switch is on | status line only while on; 重新检查 re-reads; a `needs-password` reading shows as 连接失败, never 需要密码 | PASS | The position in 设置 (智能 › 科学记忆, after 专家) and the page's own data read are covered by the desktop unit suite (`settings-pages.test.tsx`). The repository E2E layer (`pnpm ci:e2e`, a frozen plan of 133 journeys over its mocked stacks — research, standard, literature, governed) ran 133 planned / 133 executed / 127 passed / 6 failed / 0 skipped on `06f8c1cc`. This diff changes no file under `apps/web`, and the layer brings its stacks up through `scripts/start-stack.sh`, which this diff does not modify. At `06f8c1cc` no failure was in the changed surface: | Journey | Expected | Actual | Attribution | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `journey-jiuwen-configuration-on-demand` | the journey runs and reports its own result | fixture exited: `Formal journey requires an immutable candidate; E2E_DIAGNOSTIC_DIRTY=1 only labels diagnostic worktree runs` — `'M .gitignore' !== ''` | the worktree this run used carries an unrelated uncommitted `.gitignore` edit (a `dist-demo/` line, not part of this branch); the journey's guard refuses to run on a dirty candidate tree, so no product assertion was evaluated | | `journey-artifact-viewer-large-screen` J309 | a paragraph in the enlarged artifact viewer keeps a ≤ 760px measure | 774px | web layout measurement; `apps/web` untouched here | | `journey-model-connect-wizard` | the connect card stays under 580px | 598.2px | same: web layout measurement | | `journey-error-diagnostics` (en, zh-CN) | `.session-bar-session` is visible after `page.goto("/")` | element not found | web shell; reproduces with an emptied runtime data directory | | `journey-prepare-environment` J3 | the managed Python base reaches `ready` | `BLOCKED: managed Python base is not ready (failed: micromamba setup failed)` | the pinned micromamba release is on `github.com`, which this host cannot reach | The two earlier failures this layer showed — `journey-compact-process`, one of them failing with the suite's own instruction to reset the E2E layer's data directory — were stale state in the reused `.tmp/ci-runtime` workspace; this final run used a cleaned data directory (Python envs kept) and neither reproduces. ## Screenshots Captured in the desktop app running against this machine's live control plane (the Vite front end on `:5175`, the API on `:4312`, and the real memory sidecar), 1440×900, in 中文 and English. Evidence frames come from the session **BRCA1 literature and publication trends**; artifact frames from **Adult vs Pediatric Liver Immune Pathway Comparison**, whose `out/report/top14_pathways.tsv` records a dependency on `out/fig_top14_pathways_adult_vs_pediatric.png`. **Before** is the same live stack with the front end at `e4c206d1`; **after** is this PR's head. ### 中文 **报告的引用。** 同一份报告的同一段：`e4c206d1` 上 `[evidence4]`、`[evidence5]` 是字面文字；本 PR 里它们成为可点的引用。 | 前（`e4c206d1`） | 后（本 PR） | | --- | --- | | | | **证据卡片。** 预览给出证据本身的字段（类型、定位、置信度、记录时间），溯源是图谱记录的那条线（证据 → 文献）。文献摘要按正文分段显示：来源返回的是带 `

` 小标题的 HTML，卡片只取正文（小标题是出版方的导航，不是摘要本身），并给出来源链接。 | 预览 | 溯源 | | --- | --- | | | | **产物弹窗。** 引用固定版本打开（这里是 v1，版本选择器停在引用固定的那个版本上），溯源页给出产物自己的记录：上游是哪张图、跑过的代码与执行日志。 | 预览（版本选择器停在引用固定的 v1） | 溯源 | | --- | --- | | | | **上游文件。** 依赖在弹窗旁边的面板里打开，弹窗让位，不替换读者正在读的文档。 | | **设置 › 智能 › 科学记忆。** 状态行只在开关打开时出现，`重新检查` 是读者按的那一次读取；开关关闭后状态行随开关一起消失。 | 开启，运行正常 | 开启，连接失败 | | --- | --- | | | | | 关闭：没有状态行 | | --- | | | **卡片的失败状态。** 服务未开启与服务不可达是两种说法，各自给出下一步；都不会画一条空的故事线。 | 服务未开启 | 服务不可达 | | --- | --- | | | | **设置里的位置。** `智能` 分组原本没有 `科学记忆`，本 PR 把它放在 `专家` 之后（前图停在 `专家`，后图停在 `科学记忆`）。 | 前（`e4c206d1`） | 后（本 PR） | | --- | --- | | | | ### English **A report's citations.** The same passage of the same report: on `e4c206d1`, `[evidence4]` and `[evidence5]` are literal text; here they are pressable citations. | Before (`e4c206d1`) | After (this PR) | | --- | --- | | | | **The evidence card.** Preview shows the evidence's own fields; provenance is the line the graph recorded (evidence → paper). | Preview | Provenance | | --- | --- | | | | **The artifact dialog.** A citation opens the version it pins — v1 here, and the picker stays on it — and provenance is the artifact's own record: the figure it derives from, the script that ran, its execution log. | Preview (picker on the citation's v1) | Provenance | | --- | --- | | | | **上游文件.** The dependency opens in the panel beside the dialog, which steps aside instead of replacing the document the reader was in. | | **Settings › Intelligence › Scientific memory.** The state line appears only while the switch is on, `Check again` is the reader's press rather than a timer, and turning the switch off takes the line away with it. | On, running | On, cannot connect | | --- | --- | | | | | Off: no state line | | --- | | | **The card's failure states.** Off and unreachable are different readings, each with its own next step; neither draws an empty story. | Off | Unreachable | | --- | --- | | | | **Where it lives in Settings.** The `Intelligence` group had no `Scientific memory` entry; this PR adds it after `Specialists` (the before frame sits on Specialists, the after one on Scientific memory). | Before (`e4c206d1`) | After (this PR) | | --- | --- | | | | ## Release Release category: release:feature User impact: a final report's scientific citations become pressable chips that open the cited evidence or artifact with its provenance; 设置 › 科学记忆 reports the service's state beside the switch and only while the switch is on. Compatibility and migration: reports written before the server back-fills `references`, and reports whose aliases resolve to nothing, render exactly as they did before — the citation surfaces add nothing to what is stored. Two launcher behaviours change, both in `scripts/start-stack.mjs` (the Windows/host-process entry point; `start-stack.sh` is untouched): - **The sidecar's store moves under the stack's data directory.** The `.mjs` stack now passes `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_DATA_DIR=/memory-graph` (by default `.sciencediscovery-data/memory-graph`), where it previously left the sidecar to its own default, `~/.science-agent/memory-graph`. The new default keeps the graph inside the data directory the rest of the app already owns, and an explicit `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_DATA_DIR` is still honoured verbatim. **An installation that already has a graph at the old default opens an empty one after upgrading.** To keep it, set `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_DATA_DIR` to the old path, or move `~/.science-agent/memory-graph` to `/memory-graph` before the first start. Nothing is migrated automatically, and nothing needs to be: a report's `references` still name the same node ids, so pointing the variable back at the old store restores every existing citation as it was written. - **An unhealthy memory-graph no longer aborts the stack.** The `.mjs` stack warns, stops the child, and lets the API report `memoryGraph="degraded"` on `/api/health`, which is the state the settings line and the card already show; `start-stack.sh` still calls `wait_healthy` unguarded and aborts under `set -euo pipefail`. The divergence is deliberate — scientific memory is optional and the reader toggles it, and the bash entry point is left as-is for Linux/macOS and Docker users — and it is stated in the file's header. The URL follows the same rule: when this stack starts its own sidecar the API is pointed at the port it binds (an inherited `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_URL` is ignored with a warning), and when it starts none — `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_AVAILABLE=0`, or no Python — the operator's explicit URL is kept as-is. The chip URL gained a `?v=` suffix so two versions of one artifact stay distinct. It is built and parsed in memory only; no stored field, API response or persisted report carries it.
